entries.title: GitHub Rate Limit State
entries.bucketKey: githubBudgetKey(resource, credential): installation-<app-id>-<installation-id>/<resource> for positively identified installation tokens matching both configured broker pins, resolved in-process or through unexpired owner-checked bindings in the selected store, token-<sha256-prefix-24>/<resource> otherwise, adapter:<selector>/<resource> for unbound adapter auth, operator-cli/<resource> for bounded operator reads without an environment token, or bare resource for legacy unscoped default callers
entries.bindingStore: Broker-verified { digest, credential, expiresAt } files: expiry capped at one hour or earlier token expiry, prune expired digest files on write (not crashed-writer temporary files), atomic 0600 files in 0700 directories; same owner-scoped store plan with caller path then process path fallback, without inheriting tokens; reject foreign owners and observed symlinks on read, assuming a trusted parent against concurrent directory replacement; successful reads revalidate each lookup, misses cache one second per resolved path/digest; unavailable bindings retain token isolation
entries.ownerScopedStore: GHSTATEOWNER-01: a caller that does not own the shared store (file owner, or directory owner before the file exists) uses <store without .json>.uid-<uid>.json with its own .lock and .throttled.json; it never writes the shared store, and no writer renames over a store it could not read
entries.compatibility: Additive installation keys share verified token rotations; PAT fallbacks and unverified credentials remain token-keyed. Legacy resource-keyed documents remain anonymous. Deficit episodes persist across restarts; HTTP responses and credential bindings are distinct from logical attempts.
entries.operatorCredentialScope: src/operator-gh-read.mjs supplies the operator-cli fallback for credential-less admission and response recording. Explicit tokens retain their normal identity. No document-version or bucket-field changes.
